jobs.title: Program Manager, Domains and Off-Platform Enforcement
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a Program Manager to lead strategy and operations for domain registration management and off\-platform enforcement programs. In this role, you will drive large\-scale efforts to detect, investigate, and remediate abuse involving domain infrastructure and off\-platform activity that threatens Meta's users, products, and brand integrity. You will partner with legal, policy, trust and safety, and engineering teams to build scalable enforcement workflows, shape program strategy, and influence how Meta responds to evolving threats across the domain ecosystem.  

  

  

### **Program Manager, Domains and Off\-Platform Enforcement Responsibilities:**

* Develop and drive the strategy and roadmap for domain registration management and off\-platform enforcement programs, aligning cross\-functional stakeholders across legal, policy, trust and safety, and engineering
* Identify systemic gaps in domain abuse detection and off\-platform threat response, and design scalable operational interventions to close them
* Manage large\-scale enforcement workflows including domain takedowns, registrar escalations, and coordinated off\-platform abuse response operations
* Define program goals and success metrics, track performance against enforcement SLAs, and communicate progress and risks transparently to leadership and key stakeholders
* Evaluate tradeoffs between enforcement speed, legal risk, and operational capacity, and hold teams accountable to aligned priorities
* Leverage AI\-integrated workflows to streamline abuse signal triage, enforcement documentation, and cross\-functional coordination at scale
* Build and maintain relationships with domain registrars, registries, and external trust and safety partners to support enforcement escalations and policy alignment
* Coach peers on optimizing enforcement processes and simplifying operational workflows to improve system\-wide efficiency
* Proactively identify emerging off\-platform threat vectors and develop risk mitigation strategies that account for broader business and legal implications
* Create and deliver clear, structured communications on program status, enforcement outcomes, and strategic recommendations for diverse audiences including executive leadership

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8\+ years of experience in program management, trust and safety operations, or enforcement operations within a technology, legal, or domain services environment
* 8\+ years of experience managing cross\-functional programs involving legal, policy, and technical stakeholders with demonstrated ability to drive alignment and execution independently
* Experience with domain name systems, domain abuse enforcement, registrar or registry operations, or off\-platform threat response programs
* Experience defining program strategy, setting measurable goals, and tracking enforcement outcomes against operational metrics
* Experience communicating complex enforcement or operational decisions in writing to technical and non\-technical audiences, including leadership

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Track record of building enforcement programs from early\-stage design through scaled operational execution in a fast\-moving environment
* Experience working directly with domain registrars, registries, or ICANN\-related policy bodies on abuse mitigation or enforcement escalations
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience applying AI or automation tools to scale trust and safety or enforcement operations workflows
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Familiarity with legal frameworks governing domain disputes, intellectual property enforcement, or platform liability as they relate to off\-platform abuse
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)

jobs.title: Field Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
**Field Implementation Manager**


**Location:** Remote (U.S. and near a major airport) / Travel onsite to dealerships is required.


**Schedule:** Standard business hours. Approximately 3 weeks per month of onsite travel across the U.S. and Canada.


**About Numa**



Numa is building the platform to power AI\-native dealerships, rearchitecting automotive service and sales with advanced AI agents that automate customer interactions, streamline operations, and reimagine how dealerships work. Numa integrates AI into every aspect of dealership functions—from rescuing customer calls and voicemails that generate more revenue, to reducing customer resolution times that drive overall customer satisfaction (CSI), to improving dealership team productivity and accountability. Numa has raised $50 million from leading investors (Google, Threshold, Costanoa, Mitsui, and Touring Capital).


**The Role**



We're looking for a Field Implementation Manager to bring Numa's AI\-powered platform to life inside dealerships across North America. In this role, you will spend most of your time on\-site launching Numa; training staff, solving real\-time challenges, and setting teams up for long\-term success.



This isn't a behind the desk job. You'll be part trainer, part problem\-solver, part motivator; showing dealership teams the value of using Numa every day and making sure our solution sticks. You'll also serve as the bridge between the field and our internal teams, sharing insights that shape how we scale onboarding and rollout.



The ideal candidate thrives in fast\-paced environments, builds trust quickly, and loves being in the field. You take initiative, adapt to any audience, and are energized by the challenge of driving successful go\-lives without heavy direction.


**What You'll Do**


* Lead onsite go\-lives and ensure smooth, successful launches
* Train dealership staff across roles with clear, hands\-on, and engaging sessions
* Partner with dealership leaders to highlight the long\-term business value of Numa
* Document launch outcomes and transition accounts to our Performance Architect team
* Share field insights with Sales, Product, and Customer Success to improve onboarding and customer experience
* Travel onsite to dealerships regularly to drive engagement and adoption


**What You Bring**


* 1\+ years of customer\-facing experience in training, onboarding, service, or support
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to command a room and adapt to any audience
* Tech\-savvy, with the ability to quickly learn new systems and tools
* High emotional intelligence, with the ability to build trust quickly in fast\-paced environments
* Excitement to travel \~3 weeks per month across the U.S. and Canada (must live near a major airport)


**Nice To Have**


* Experience with SaaS, automotive, or phone systems
* Background in field\-based training, deployment, or customer onboarding
* Familiarity with dealership operations or service department workflows
* Experience supporting product go\-lives or rollouts in a high\-growth environment
* Comfort using AI tools to streamline training, documentation, or workflows
* Bilingual (English/French or English/Spanish) for broader coverage across the U.S. and Canada


**What Success Looks Like**


* Deliver smooth, successful go\-lives that set dealership teams up for long\-term adoption
* Build trusted relationships with dealership staff and leadership during launch
* Ensure Numa becomes part of dealership teams' daily workflow
* Enable seamless account transitions to the Performance Architect team
* Consistently surface field insights that improve how Numa scales onboarding and rollout


**Why Join Numa**


* We believe in everyone's growth.
* Be part of an industry leader named the \#1 fastest\-growing AI Automotive company by Inc. 5000\.
* Represent category\-defining AI technology that is transforming the automotive industry.
* Join a high\-growth organization with significant opportunities for career advancement.


**Compensation \& Benefits**


* Base Salary: $78,000 USD
* Equity Package
* Flexible PTO
* Health, dental, and vision benefits
* 401(k) plan


At Numa, you'll have the chance to represent game\-changing technology in an industry that's ready for innovation. If you love being in the field, thrive on solving problems in real time, and want to make an impact at a high\-growth company, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: CRM & Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**About brightfin**



brightfin is the AI\-powered Financial Management Intelligence Platform for Enterprise IT, helping Fortune 500 and mid\-market CFOs, CIOs, and IT finance teams understand, govern, and optimize technology spend across telecom, FinOps, and IT asset management. Our customers include large healthcare systems, financial institutions, and global enterprises — organizations where data security and trust are non\-negotiable.

  

**Job summary**



brightfin's sales team is growing, and the systems and processes behind it need to grow with it. The CRM \& Ops Analyst owns the day\-to\-day health of brightfin's CRM (Zoho) and the operational backbone that supports the sales team: clean data, reliable reporting, and processes that hold up as headcount increases. You'll be the person sales, sales leadership, and cross\-functional partners in marketing, finance, and customer success turn to when they need the pipeline data or process to be right the first time.

  

This is a hands\-on, individual\-contributor role at a company still building its sales operations function from a small base — expect to work close to the details, not just the strategy.

 **Essential functions**

 ***CRM administration (Zoho)***


* Own day\-to\-day administration of Zoho CRM: user and role management, workflow and automation configuration, field and layout changes, and third\-party integrations.
* Creation of new automations to support increased deal volume as the company scales.
* Maintain data integrity — deduplication, validation rules, and routine audits — so pipeline, account, and contact data can be trusted.
* Document CRM configuration and processes so they're repeatable as the sales team scales.


***Sales operations support***


* Support pipeline management, forecasting, and quota tracking for the sales team.
* Support the deal desk approval process — tracking deal terms and approvals and flagging exceptions for Sales Operations and Finance.
* Manage lead routing and territory assignment rules in partnership with marketing and sales leadership.
* Execute post\-sale deals processing for handoff to finance and customer success.
* Use of AI tools to increase sales and marketing efficiency.


***Reporting and analytics***


* Build and maintain dashboards and reports covering pipeline health, funnel conversion, quota attainment, and other core sales KPIs.
* Prepare recurring reporting for sales leadership, and ad hoc analysis to support board and leadership\-level questions.
* Identify trends and process breakdowns in the data and bring them to Sales Operations leadership with a recommendation, not just a chart.


***Cross\-functional coordination***


* Partner with marketing on lead handoff and campaign tracking inside the CRM.
* Partner with customer success and finance on renewal and account data continuity as deals move from sales to post\-sale.
* Serve as a point of contact for sales reps on day\-to\-day CRM questions and requests.
* Cross\-train with Sales Operations on order form \& contract generation, board \& leadership collateral preparation, sales onboarding, and sales training.

  


**Qualifications**


**Experience**


* 2–4 years of experience in sales operations, revenue operations, CRM administration, or a business/data analyst role.
* Hands\-on CRM administration experience — Zoho, Salesforce, HubSpot, or a comparable platform. Zoho experience is a strong plus given brightfin's stack.
* Experience in a B2B SaaS environment preferred.
* Experience with sales onboarding \& training a plus.


**Skills and competencies**


* Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills; comfortable building dashboards in tools like Zoho Analytics, Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.
* High attention to detail and a strong bias toward clean, trustworthy data.
* Process\-minded — able to document and improve a workflow, not just execute it.
* Comfortable in a small, fast\-moving operations team where the function is still being built.
* SQL/lead flow proficiency is a plus, not a requirement.


**Education**


* Bachelor's degree in business, analytics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.


**Preferred qualifications**


* Direct Zoho CRM administration experience.
* Experience supporting a deal desk or deal\-approval workflow.
* Experience at a PE\-backed or growth\-stage SaaS company.
* Familiarity with IT spend management, FinOps, TEM, or ITFM, or the ServiceNow ecosystem.

  


**Compensation \& Benefits:**

  

* brightfin offers a comprehensive health, dental and vision benefits package.
* Paid time off. We strongly believe in work\-life balance and taking time for yourself.
* 401K with employer match
* Compensation Range: $60,000 \- $70,000 / Year

Please note: While we prefer someone based in Bethesda, we are also open to candidates in South Florida or Atlanta, GA.

***Who We Are***

**AIR Communities** is a Real Estate Investment Trust headquartered in Denver, CO. We are one of the country's largest owners and operators of multifamily housing, managing high\-quality properties in most major markets. **At AIR, we value integrity, respect, collaboration, customer focus, and performance.** These values are brought to life by our teammates, who are ultimately responsible for our success. When you join our team, you'll work alongside the most dedicated professionals in the industry and **open the door to unlimited career opportunities.**

**We seek motivated professionals who excel in customer service and thrive in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment. If you're inclined towards more challenging tasks and aspire to exceed expectations, our environment may align better with your ambitions, join us!**

**Where You Will Work:**  

Our east regional office is located in Bethesda, MD.  

AIR values relationships and the benefits from working side by side with teammates, therefore this position will be **in\-office 5 days a week** to support the team.

 **Job Description** **Project Leadership**

* Lead large\-scale capital improvement and asset enhancement projects across AIR's multifamily portfolio, overseeing renovations from initial concept development through project completion.
* Manage complex projects including hallway renovations, leasing office transformations, common area repositioning, operational space redesigns, package locker relocations, and other high\-impact property improvement initiatives.
* Partner with internal stakeholders, property operations teams, architects, designers, consultants, and vendors to develop project strategies that enhance resident experience and property performance.
* Oversee projects typically ranging from **$100K to $500k\+**, including multi\-floor, multi\-phase renovations executed over several months.
* Drive all phases of project execution, including project scoping, design development, budgeting, bidding, contracting, scheduling, implementation, and closeout.
* Serve as the primary point of accountability for vendor performance, ensuring quality, budget compliance, schedule adherence, and successful project outcomes.
* Lead project kickoff meetings and establish clear expectations, communication plans, milestones, and success metrics.
